Title: Set up project skeleton (frontend, backend, database)
User Story: As a developer, I want a modular project skeleton so that each team member can build their module independently.
Acceptance Criteria: Frontend, backend and database folders created as per SAD; App runs locally with a single documented command; README lists setup steps

Title: Enable GitHub Actions CI and protect main branch
User Story: As the team, we want every push and PR checked automatically, and main protected, so unreviewed code never reaches main.
Acceptance Criteria: CI workflow runs on every push and pull request; Branch rule on main: PR required, 1 approval, status check 'build' must pass, force push blocked; Every member raises one practice PR during dry run

Title: Document team roles, branches and merge order in the README
User Story: As a team member, I want the README to explain who owns which module, which branch to use and the order PRs are merged, so that sprint PRs merge cleanly.
Acceptance Criteria: README lists each member's role, branch and modules; Sprint 1 and Sprint 2 merge order documented; Review rules (1 approval, green build check, Merge not Close) documented; Project structure and traceability tables match the current code and test files

Title: Add GitHub issue templates for bug reports and user stories
User Story: As a tester, I want a bug report template linked to our test case IDs so that defects found during testing are reported consistently.
Acceptance Criteria: 'Bug report' template asks for test case ID, steps, expected vs actual result, severity; 'User story' template asks for SRS ID, story, acceptance criteria, story points; Templates appear when clicking New issue on GitHub

Title: User account creation
User Story: As a general user, I want to create an account so that I can access registered-user features.
Acceptance Criteria: Registration page accepts name, email and password; Account stored with role 'User'; Duplicate email is rejected with a clear message

Title: Validate registration information
User Story: As a user, I want the form to tell me what is missing or invalid so that I can register successfully.
Acceptance Criteria: Required fields checked on client and server; Email format and minimum password length validated; Field-level error messages shown

Title: Login and logout
User Story: As a registered user, I want to log in and log out so that my account is secure.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid credentials start a session/token; Invalid credentials show an error without revealing which field was wrong; Logout ends the session

Title: Restrict administrative functions to administrators
User Story: As an administrator, I want admin features restricted to my role so that legal content cannot be changed by others.
Acceptance Criteria: Role-based check on all admin routes/APIs; Non-admin access returns 403 and hides admin UI; BR-04 satisfied

Title: Submit legal question in natural language
User Story: As a user, I want to type my legal question in plain language so that I don't need legal knowledge to ask.
Acceptance Criteria: Chat/query interface with text box and submit button; Query sent to backend API; Loading state shown while waiting

Title: Validate query input
User Story: As a user, I want empty or meaningless queries to be caught so that I get useful feedback instead of an error.
Acceptance Criteria: Empty, whitespace-only and over-length queries rejected; Validation on both client and server; Friendly message explains what to enter

Title: Generate informational AI response
User Story: As a user, I want an AI-generated informational answer to my question so that I understand my legal situation.
Acceptance Criteria: Backend integrates the chosen LLM/NLP service; Prompt restricts answers to Indian legal context (BR-01); Errors/timeouts from the AI service handled gracefully

Title: Present responses in a clear, structured format
User Story: As a user, I want the answer split into clear sections so that it is easy to read.
Acceptance Criteria: Response shows sections: Summary, Category, Steps, When to consult a lawyer, References, Disclaimer; Readable on mobile and desktop; Long answers do not break layout

Title: Display legal disclaimer with responses
User Story: As a user, I want to see a disclaimer with every legal answer so that I know it is not professional advice.
Acceptance Criteria: Disclaimer shown on every legal response; Wording approved by team and matches BR-02/BR-03; Disclaimer cannot be hidden by the user

Title: Classify legal queries into categories
User Story: As a user, I want my question categorised (e.g. Consumer, Property, Family, Criminal, Labour, Cyber) so that I get relevant guidance.
Acceptance Criteria: At least 6 categories supported; Classifier returns category plus 'Other/Unsupported'; Unit tests with sample queries per category

Title: Display identified legal category
User Story: As a user, I want to see which legal area my issue falls under so that I understand the context.
Acceptance Criteria: Category badge displayed in the response; Hidden when category is 'Other/Unsupported'

Title: Provide procedure steps for identified issue
User Story: As a user, I want general step-by-step procedures for my issue so that I know what to do next.
Acceptance Criteria: Curated procedure steps stored per category; Steps shown as a numbered list; Steps sourced from approved legal information

Title: Indicate when professional legal help is required
User Story: As a user, I want to be told when my situation needs a lawyer or official confirmation so that I don't rely only on the app.
Acceptance Criteria: Rules/keywords flag serious matters (e.g. criminal charges, court notices); Visible 'Consult a lawyer' notice shown when flagged

Title: Retrieve relevant legal references
User Story: As a user, I want relevant Acts, sections and case laws for my query so that I can read the actual source.
Acceptance Criteria: Reference dataset stored (Reference_ID, Title, Category, Source, Description); References matched by category/keywords; API returns top matches

Title: Display legal reference details
User Story: As a user, I want to see title, source and short description of each reference so that I can judge its relevance.
Acceptance Criteria: References section in response and a standalone references page; Source link shown where available

Title: Indicate when no reference is available
User Story: As a user, I want to be told when no reference exists so that I am not misled.
Acceptance Criteria: 'No suitable reference found' message when no matches; No fabricated references are shown

Title: Display available document templates
User Story: As a user, I want to browse available legal templates so that I can find the one I need.
Acceptance Criteria: Templates page lists templates grouped by category; At least 5 templates (e.g. RTI application, consumer complaint, rent agreement, affidavit, legal notice)

Title: Explain purpose of each template
User Story: As a user, I want a short explanation of each template so that I know when to use it.
Acceptance Criteria: Each template shows description/purpose; Disclaimer shown on template pages

Title: View or generate supported templates
User Story: As a user, I want to fill in my details and generate a template so that I get a ready draft document.
Acceptance Criteria: User can view full template; Form fills placeholders and generates the document; Generated document can be copied or downloaded

Title: Store queries and responses for registered users
User Story: As a registered user, I want my questions and answers saved so that I can come back to them.
Acceptance Criteria: Query stored with Query_ID, User_ID, Query_Text, Category, Response, Timestamp; Only stored for logged-in users

Title: View own query history
User Story: As a registered user, I want to view my previous queries so that I can revisit earlier guidance.
Acceptance Criteria: History page lists past queries, newest first; Clicking an entry shows full response; Users can only see their own history

Title: Submit feedback
User Story: As a user, I want to give feedback on a response so that the system can be improved.
Acceptance Criteria: Feedback form (rating + comment) on responses; Feedback saved and confirmation shown

Title: Admin: manage approved legal information
User Story: As an administrator, I want to add, edit and remove approved legal information so that responses stay accurate.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin dashboard with CRUD for legal information/procedure steps; Changes reflected in user responses; Admin-only access (FR-04)

Title: Admin: manage legal references and templates
User Story: As an administrator, I want to manage references and templates so that users see up-to-date content.
Acceptance Criteria: CRUD for references and templates in admin dashboard; Input validated before saving

Title: Admin: review submitted feedback
User Story: As an administrator, I want to review user feedback so that I can find and fix problems.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin dashboard lists feedback with rating, comment, date; Feedback can be marked as reviewed

Title: Responses within reasonable time
User Story: As a user, I want answers quickly so that the app feels responsive.
Acceptance Criteria: Target: AI response under 10 s for typical queries (measured and recorded); Non-AI pages load under 2 s

Title: Process queries without unnecessary delays
User Story: As a user, I want no avoidable waiting so that my experience is smooth.
Acceptance Criteria: Non-blocking/async calls to AI service; Static legal data cached; Timeout configured for AI calls

Title: Support multiple concurrent users
User Story: As the team, we want the prototype to handle several users at once so that the demo is reliable.
Acceptance Criteria: Simple load test with at least 10 concurrent users; No errors or data mix-up between users

Title: Communicate output is informational, not legal advice
User Story: As a user, I want it made clear the output is informational so that I am not misled.
Acceptance Criteria: Disclaimer on home page, response and template pages; Shown on first use/registration

Title: Avoid presenting uncertain information as guaranteed
User Story: As a user, I want uncertain answers to be marked uncertain so that I don't treat them as guaranteed.
Acceptance Criteria: System prompt forbids guaranteed outcomes; Hedging language for uncertain cases; Tested with sample queries

Title: Encourage consulting a qualified lawyer when needed
User Story: As a user, I want to be advised to see a lawyer when needed so that I get proper help.
Acceptance Criteria: Lawyer recommendation shown whenever FR-13 flags a query; Link/info for free legal aid (e.g. NALSA) shown

Title: Authenticate before account-specific information
User Story: As a registered user, I want my data shown only after login so that others cannot see it.
Acceptance Criteria: Protected routes require valid session/token; Unauthenticated requests redirected to login / return 401

Title: Authorization for administrative functions
User Story: As an administrator, I want admin APIs authorized server-side so that they cannot be bypassed.
Acceptance Criteria: Server-side role check on every admin API; Tests confirm non-admin gets 403

Title: Protect user information and stored queries
User Story: As a user, I want my information and queries kept private so that my legal issues stay confidential.
Acceptance Criteria: Queries filtered by User_ID on every read; Secrets/API keys in environment variables, not code; Input sanitised against injection

Title: Secure HTTPS communication
User Story: As a user, I want my data sent over HTTPS so that it cannot be intercepted.
Acceptance Criteria: Deployed app served over HTTPS; HTTP redirects to HTTPS

Title: Passwords not stored in plain text
User Story: As a user, I want my password hashed so that it is safe even if the database leaks.
Acceptance Criteria: Passwords hashed with bcrypt/argon2; No password in logs or API responses

Title: Usability for non-technical users
User Story: As a non-technical user, I want a simple interface so that I can use the app without help.
Acceptance Criteria: Consistent navigation across pages; Plain-language labels, no legal jargon in UI; Responsive layout

Title: Maintainability through modular components
User Story: As a developer, I want separate modules (auth, query, classification, references, templates, history, admin) so that each can change independently.
Acceptance Criteria: Each feature in its own module/folder; Modules communicate through defined APIs/interfaces

Title: Reliability: handle invalid or unsupported inputs gracefully
User Story: As a user, I want helpful messages instead of crashes so that I can continue using the app.
Acceptance Criteria: Global error handler on backend; User-friendly error pages/messages on frontend; Unsupported topics get a polite 'out of scope' message

Title: Testability: independently testable modules
User Story: As a tester, I want unit tests per module so that each can be verified on its own.
Acceptance Criteria: Unit tests for each major module as per Test Plan; Tests run automatically in CI

Title: Portability across modern browsers
User Story: As a user, I want the app to work in my browser so that I can use any device.
Acceptance Criteria: Tested on Chrome, Edge, Firefox and one mobile browser; Results recorded in test report

Title: Record 1-minute Sprint 1 demo video and upload to repo
User Story: As the team, we need a short video of the working Sprint 1 product as the sprint deliverable.
Acceptance Criteria: 1-minute video of working product; Uploaded to repo (demo/ folder) via PR

Title: Record 2-minute Sprint 2 demo video and upload to repo
User Story: As the team, we need a video of the final working product as the Sprint 2 deliverable.
Acceptance Criteria: 2-minute video of final working product; Uploaded to repo (demo/ folder) via PR

Title: Complete documentation and deviation log; freeze development
User Story: As the team, we need final documentation, including deviations from SRS/SAD/Test Plan, ready for the final demo.
Acceptance Criteria: README, setup guide and user guide complete; DEVIATIONS.md lists every change from submitted SRS/SAD/Test Plan with reason; Release tag created to freeze development

Title: Case status: mark cases Open or Resolved
User Story: As a registered user, I want to mark each saved question (case) as open or resolved so that I can track which problems are still pending.
Acceptance Criteria: New cases start as Open; User can mark a case Resolved and reopen it; My cases page filters by All / Open / Resolved; Recorded as deviation D-01

Title: User dashboard and profile
User Story: As a registered user, I want a dashboard and profile page so that I can see my cases at a glance and manage my account.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows total/open/resolved counts, recent cases and cases by legal area; Profile lets the user edit their name and change password (current password required); Recorded as deviation D-02

Title: Case progress tracking and document checklist
User Story: As a user, I want to tick off the suggested steps and see which documents I need so that I can follow my case step by step.
Acceptance Criteria: Each case shows its procedure steps as a checklist that can be ticked; Progress (e.g. 2 of 5 steps) shown on the case and dashboard; Category-wise list of documents to keep ready; Recorded as a deviation

Title: Admin analytics, reports and user management
User Story: As an administrator, I want usage analytics, reports and a user list so that I can monitor the system.
Acceptance Criteria: Charts/tables: questions per category, per day, average rating; Downloadable CSV report; User list with role change (user/admin); Recorded as a deviation
